name: Hello Toggle
description: Simple Hello World app with a button that changes the text label

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Main screen with animated text and button to change messages

features.name: animated-text
features.description: Large animated text label that changes on button press with scale effects

features.name: gradient-button
features.description: Pressable button with gradient background that triggers text change

features.name: message-cycle
features.description: Cycles through themed messages with smooth fade transitions

features.name: press-counter
features.description: Displays total button presses with animated counter

screens.layout: Centered layout with gradient background, large animated text, gradient button below, and press counter at bottom

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Shows chronological list of all button presses with timestamps

features.name: press-list
features.description: Scrollable list of button presses with message and timestamp

features.name: relative-time
features.description: Shows relative time for each press using date-fns

features.name: swipe-delete
features.description: Swipe gesture to delete individual history entries

features.name: share-history
features.description: Share button to export history as text

screens.layout: Full-screen FlatList with card items showing message, theme color indicator, timestamp, and swipe actions

screens.name: Themes
screens.purpose: Grid of theme cards to customize message sets and gradients

features.name: theme-grid
features.description: Grid layout displaying available themes with gradient previews

features.name: theme-selection
features.description: Tap to select active theme with haptic feedback

features.name: preview-messages
features.description: Shows sample messages when long-pressing theme card

features.name: active-indicator
features.description: Animated checkmark on currently selected theme

screens.layout: Two-column grid of theme cards with gradient backgrounds, theme names, and selection indicators

screens.name: Stats
screens.purpose: Visual statistics and charts about button press patterns

features.name: total-presses
features.description: Large animated counter showing total button presses

features.name: press-chart
features.description: Bar chart showing presses per theme using SVG

features.name: time-breakdown
features.description: Pie chart of presses by time of day

features.name: streaks
features.description: Shows longest streak and current streak with icons

screens.layout: Scrollable view with stat cards at top, followed by SVG charts and streak information

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: App preferences including haptics, animations, and data management

features.name: haptics-toggle
features.description: Switch to enable or disable haptic feedback

features.name: animation-slider
features.description: Slider to adjust animation speed from slow to fast

features.name: clear-data
features.description: Button to clear all history with confirmation alert

features.name: app-info
features.description: Displays app version and credits with icons

screens.layout: Grouped list layout with setting sections, toggles, sliders, and action buttons in dark cards
